audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart (phases[].side and win[]) gave Kayle levels 2 and 3 and called 4-5 a skill lane, while the prose (whys[1], whys[2], whys[3], early) and the packet levelChart both say Galio owns levels 2 through 5.
audit.why: Kayle is melee with one point in W until 6; Winds of War (Q, 11s rank 1) plus a Colossal Smash empowered auto out-trade her, and Shield of Durand's taunt into Justice Punch is a free dive setup on the squishiest top laner.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-3 flipped to Galio, row 4 flipped to Kayle, proposed as one atomic group across both layers, with the matching phases[].why rewritten so the chart and the prose agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why said only 'Galio's ultimate changes the math' with no number and no statement of what actually flips at 6.
audit.why: Level 6 is the whole matchup: Divine Ascent makes Kayle's autos ranged and Divine Judgment gives invulnerability; Hero's Entrance is a 180/160/140s cooldown, so surviving one use of it is a real window.
audit.corrected: Level-6 phase now names Divine Ascent, R invulnerability, kiting outside Winds of War, and the 180s Hero's Entrance.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly called the taunt 'W taunt (Justice Punch)'. Justice Punch is Galio's E (dash + knockup, 11/10/9/8/7); the taunt is Shield of Durand (W, 18/17/16/15/14). 'passive autos' was never named as Colossal Smash.
audit.why: Riot's kit data is authoritative on slot names; a player tracking the wrong cooldown tracks the wrong window.
audit.corrected: whys[2], early, mid, wants.foe[1] and dosFull[0].d now use Justice Punch (E) for the knockup and Shield of Durand (W) for the taunt, with the E cooldown stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said Justice Punch cuts Kayle's retreat and that Kayle has no dash of her own.
audit.why: Listed in _missing for this exact matchup; Kayle's only escape is W move speed and Flash.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now tells the reader to hold Flash for the Justice Punch cut-off rather than for damage.

edits.before: E-poke softens his step-ups while you scale. Only take the trade when Galio's Justice Punch is down.
edits.after: Winds of War plus a Colossal Smash auto out-damage your melee poke — step up only with Justice Punch down.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Galio must walk into your range.
edits.after: Shield of Durand taunts you into empowered autos and you still have no ranged answer — hold the wave your side and farm.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Justice Punch's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His magic resist and Winds of War poke keep you behind while your Q shred ramps — farm safe, hold W for the field, and wait for 6.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Galio's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged and R gives invulnerability — kite outside Winds of War and pop R when his 180s Hero's Entrance dive commits.

edits.before: Galio adds his W taunt (Justice Punch) into passive autos, locking you down while you still have no ranged answer pre-6.
edits.after: Galio adds Shield of Durand (W) taunt into Colossal Smash autos, locking you down while you still have no ranged answer pre-6.

edits.before: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Justice Punch (E) is 11s at rank 1 and cuts your retreat — you have no dash, so hold Flash for it.

edits.before: Land W taunt to lock you in passive empowered-auto range and burst you before you can kite back
edits.after: Land Justice Punch into Shield of Durand's taunt to lock you in Colossal Smash range and burst you

edits.before: Galio's Q (Winds of War) drops twin tornadoes that converge into a lingering magic field, and from level 2 he can hold it on you and chunk you while you have only melee-range autos and a single point of W to heal it back. His passive (Colossal Smash) also empowers an auto for bonus magic damage on a cooldown, so he out-pokes you at melee range. Do not try to trade — your Q (Radiant Blast) skillshot pokes and shreds his MR, but it can't out-damage his sustained field, and he stacks magic resist so your damage feels weak anyway. Last-hit at max range, hold W for when his Q field actually lands on you, and respect that his W taunt (Justice Punch dash into the taunt) can lock you for a jungler dive on the squishiest top laner in the game. Concede CS rather than eat an all-in you cannot survive.
edits.after: Galio's Q (Winds of War) drops twin tornadoes that converge into a lingering magic field, and from level 2 he can hold it on you and chunk you while you have only melee-range autos and a single point of W to heal it back. His passive (Colossal Smash) also empowers an auto for bonus magic damage on a cooldown, so he out-pokes you at melee range. Do not try to trade — your Q (Radiant Blast) skillshot pokes and shreds his MR, but it can't out-damage his sustained field, and he stacks magic resist so your damage feels weak anyway. Last-hit at max range, hold W for when his Q field actually lands on you, and respect Justice Punch (E, 11s at rank 1) into Shield of Durand's taunt — that chain locks you for a jungler dive on the squishiest top laner in the game. Concede CS rather than eat an all-in you cannot survive.

edits.before: Level 6 is your release valve. Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged with bonus AoE magic damage and your R (Divine Judgment) grants a few seconds of full invulnerability, so you stop being food for his Q and his dives — now you farm from outside his Q range and pop R if a gank commits. He still wins a straight stand-and-fight because of his MR and his W taunt lock, so don't duel him; kite. Lead Q to shred his magic resist, then walk back and chip with ranged on-hits. Save R for the exact moment his jungler or his own dive commits, not for poke.

He still wins a straight stand-and-fight because of his MR and the Shield of Durand taunt, so don't duel him; kite. Lead Q to shred his magic resist, then walk back and chip with ranged on-hits. Save R for the exact moment his jungler or his own dive commits, not for poke.

notes: Level chart flipped as one atomic group (rows 1-4) in both layers to match the packet chart and the existing prose. Slot-name error corrected everywhere it appeared: Justice Punch is E (dash/knockup), Shield of Durand is W (taunt). Spell-shield/cleanse/tenacity eligibility against the taunt and the R knockup is not in the kit data, so nothing was asserted about it.
